notes: Split-screen fix: a video's reaction can never repeat old footage at the end anymore - if a traded reaction can't cover the whole video with fresh footage, the video keeps its own. Phone app sync is complete too: your video history with real dates and covers, your submitted list, campaign names and your stats all reach your phone automatically.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.56.
